entities.name: Derya Cebecioğlu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Derya Cebecioğlu is a Turkish volleyball player. She is 1.81 m tall at 69 kg (152 lb), and plays in the Outside Hitter and sometimes Opposite position. She last played for VakıfBank S.K. in Istanbul. She is a member of the Turkey women's national volleyball team.
